label: What is its own being has being according to its whole power, and consequently lacks no excellence…
paraphrase: What is its own being has being according to its whole power, and consequently lacks no excellence belonging to anything and has no defect.
note: Bare source reading, not bound to a Lean declaration; source fidelity does not establish premise truth or the applicability of its terms to current candidate roots. Aquinas applies this reasoning to God under previously established premises; this attribution is not part of the independent proposition.
